info.title: HotCodePush API
info.description: The HotCodePush REST API for the CLI, the console, the MCP server and your own scripts. Authenticate with an API token from the console as a bearer. The API is still in development: until we declare it stable, breaking changes can happen, each announced in the changelog.

get.description: The caller's pending invitations, newest first.

post.description: Accepts an invitation with the token from its mail; the caller's address must be the invited one, and the membership counts against the members limit.
Creates an app with its default channel `production`; the name is unique among the organization's live apps and the count against `apps_limit`.
Invites an address with a role and sends the invitation mail; counts against the daily invitation limit.

delete.description: Withdraws an invitation; its link stops working at once.

get.description: The organization's members, newest first; `?relations=user` embeds each member's user.

patch.description: Changes a member's role. Setting `owner` transfers ownership: only the Owner may, they become Admin in the same transaction, and the organization keeps exactly one Owner.

delete.description: Removes a member; removing others needs Admin or Owner, and any member deletes their own row to leave. The Owner leaves only after transferring ownership.

post.description: Creates an organization; the creator becomes its Owner.

201.description: The organization, with the role owner.

get.description: The caller's organizations with their roles, newest first.
The organization with its plan; any role of it.

patch.description: Changes the name and the security settings; the security settings need a paying plan, and the region is read-only after creation.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the organization: gone at once for everyone, hard-deleted after seven days with everything under it, restorable only by support within the window.

204.description: The organization is scheduled for deletion.

post.description: Creates a channel: the name is one to 64 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores and unique per app; only Owners and Admins protect one; an expiry never sits on a protected channel; the count is bounded by `channels_per_app_limit`.

get.description: One channel with the header numbers of its page; the device counts come from the registry once devices report.

patch.description: Edits the name, the protected and discoverable flags, the expiry and the auto-pause policy; every change to a protected channel is Admin or Owner, and the expiry is refused on the default channel.

delete.description: Deletes the channel with its releases: it leaves the frontier and starts its bundles' retention clocks; refused on the app's default channel.

post.description: A paused channel serves nothing new: its index carries `isPaused` and devices keep what they have — the kill switch for a whole channel.
The channel serves its frontier again.

get.description: The channel's index for a platform as the database sees it, for the probe and the verifier to compare with the copy the CDN serves.

200.description: The channel index, the wire shape the device reads.

get.description: The channel's release log, newest first, each release with the devices whose current release it is; `?relations=channel,bundle` embeds the linked rows.
get.summary: List the releases of a channel

post.description: Creates a release of a ready bundle in the channel with its conditions, rollout, mandatory flag and notes, numbered next in the channel; refused on a protected channel below Admin and past `releases_per_app_per_day_limit`; an `Idempotency-Key` answers the same release again for 24 hours.
Creates a release of the channel's previous bundle, or of the release named by `toReleaseId`, with the rollback recorded as its provenance; a rollback is a release, never a mutation.

get.description: Every release of the app, newest first, filtered by `channelId`, `bundleId` or `state`.
One release with its status — when it went live in the index and when the purge completed; `?relations=channel,bundle,counters` embeds the linked rows.

patch.description: Edits the rollout percentage in both directions — a device that has the release keeps it — the mandatory flag and the notes; the index re-materializes and devices see the change on their next check; revoked is terminal.

post.description: Stops offering the release; devices on it keep it. Admin or Owner on a protected channel.
Offers the release again and starts a new auto-pause window. Admin or Owner on a protected channel.
The release is dead: devices on it move to the newest eligible older release or the embedded bundle. Admin or Owner on a protected channel; revoked is terminal.

patch.description: Edits the name, the default channel or the deep-link template behind the QR surfaces; the template is a URI with a scheme and `{channelId}` exactly once.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the app: gone at once, its channel indexes removed from the bucket, the rows and the prefix hard-deleted after seven days; restorable only by support within the window.

204.description: The app is scheduled for deletion.

post.description: Moves the app to another organization the caller is an Admin of, in one transaction, with the target's `apps_limit` and storage limit checked; audited in both organizations.

200.description: The app, now in the target organization.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the account: gone at once, hard-deleted after seven days by a job, restorable only by support within the window. Refused while the user is the only Owner of an organization with other members.

204.description: The account is scheduled for deletion.
